On the Moon, the Rabbit ran and jumped.
Then he saw a big spaceship in the sky!
Thank you. How is Chang'e?
Chang'e is always sad, but she will be happy now.
Look, here she comes.
It's so good to have family around again!
How did you get to the Moon?

We have great spaceships in China.
Chang'e, you came to the Moon so long ago.
What did you do here?
Rabbit and I read books and sang folk songs.
But I always thought of our days together.
